nodes.description: SafeMath helper: c = a + b; require(c >= a) to guard against overflow.
SafeMath helper: require(b <= a); c = a - b to guard against underflow.
SafeMath helper: c = a * b; require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
SafeMath helper: require(b > 0); c = a / b division-by-zero guard.
Owned constructor: owner = msg.sender, establishes deployer as owner.
onlyOwner function setting newOwner (two-step ownership transfer).
Accepts ownership if msg.sender == newOwner, then owner = newOwner and newOwner = address(0).
Boldman constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to'; decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] with safeSub but never verifies the allowance is sufficient.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data).
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts().
onlyOwner function performing an external ERC20 transfer from the contract to owner on a caller-supplied token address.

Unsigned addition c = a + b guarded only by require(c >= a).
Unsigned subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
Unsigned multiplication c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Unsigned division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).

External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-supplied token contract.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] without requiring allowed >= tokens, so underflow-safe subtraction silently permits unapproved transfers.
